manifest.author: LLM supervisor (session of Issue #25)
manifest.purpose: Identify which question-frame words drive the sense task-type decision (probability mass on phys/other) by occlusion with <unk>.
manifest.hypothesis: H-physics: B's history (cross-frame consistency between S01 and S02 at step 400) made the word 'physics' - the only content word the two training frames share - the dominant type cue; S03 lacks it, so B reads S03 as numeric. Prediction: occluding 'physics' drops type mass more in B than in A, and 'quantity' contributes less in B than in A.

pool.drop <word>: mean decrease when the word is occluded

manifest.read_scope: model copies; fresh TRAINING-pool sense items (frames S01, S02); development new-frame sense set
manifest.measurement_definitions: type mass = softmax probability on {phys, other}; occlusion replaces every occurrence of the word after the last '.' (the question frame) with <unk>; drop = base - occluded, averaged over items containing the word

cases.name: occluding the causal token drops type mass
occluding an irrelevant token changes nothing
